## Summary

Implements ADR 0112 engine-native Secondary Motion. This follow-up updates the remaining Editor test fixture and Systems panel expectation to the current `engine.secondary_motion` component ID and `engine.secondary_motion_transform_propagation` runtime system ID.

The PR remains Draft while current-format-only alias cleanup, PMX best-effort conversion diagnostics, documentation updates, final Windows Validation, and Visual Validation are completed.
